5f71272c7d11faad47f918418f3f1e584242200c.query:
insert into msp(msp_id, name, legacy_id) values ($1, $2, $3) 
on conflict(name) 
    DO update 
        set 
            name = excluded.name,
            msp_id = excluded.msp_id, 
            legacy_id = excluded.legacy_id
RETURNING id

8665b6bcdca55702bb8442ae56a1259cf31a54f0.query:
select
    msp.pub_msp_id as identifier,
    tarif.slug_name as name,
    case
        when tarif.alternative_operator_name is not null then tarif.alternative_operator_name
        else msp.name
    end as "provider!",
    case
        when tarif.alternative_operator_name is not null then tarif.alternative_operator_name
        else msp.legacy_id
    end as "legacy_id!",
    charge_price.price,
    tarif.monthly_fee as monthly_fee,
    charge_price.updated
from charge_price join cpo on cpo.id = charge_price.cpo_id
                  join tarif on tarif.id = charge_price.tarif_id
                  join msp on tarif.msp_id = msp.id
where
    cpo.name = $1 and
    cpo.is_enabled and
    charge_price.c_type::text ilike $2
order by price, msp.name desc, tarif.slug_name

90079b59a18edbab17343dcad3b9522310f8d2c7.query:
INSERT INTO tarif(msp_id, relationship_id, slug_name, monthly_fee)
VALUES($1, $2, $3 ,$4)
ON CONFLICT (relationship_id)
    DO UPDATE SET slug_name = excluded.slug_name
RETURNING id

f2e00c6500b5572c193350d46e2bbebf054bf2d5.query:
insert into charge_price(cpo_id, tarif_id, c_type, price, blocking_fee_start)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) 
on conflict(cpo_id, tarif_id, c_type)
    do update 
    set price = excluded.price, 
        blocking_fee_start = excluded.blocking_fee_start,
        updated = now()
